outdatedAlert.title: {{count}} scene(s) out of sync
outdatedAlert.description: Source material changed since these scenes were generated. Review and update them before publishing.
outdatedAlert.updatePrompt: Review outdated scenes in course {{courseId}} ("{{courseTitle}}"). Load the scene-content skill first and follow its outdated-scene workflow. For each outdated scene: regenerate with insertContent if sources still contain relevant material, or call deleteScene with a clear reason if the topic was removed from sources. Deletion requires user confirmation in chat.
